1.w: And having risen up, all the multitude of them led Him to Pilate.

2.w: And they began to accuse Him, saying, “We found this [man] misleading our nation and forbidding taxes to be given to Caesar, and declaring Himself to be Christ, a King.”

3.w: And Pilate questioned Him, saying, “Are You the King of the Jews?” And answering him, He was saying, “You say.”

4.w: And Pilate said to the chief priests and the crowds, “I find no guilt in this man.”

5.w: But they kept insisting, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all of Judea, and He has begun from Galilee even to here.”

6.w: And Pilate, having heard, asked whether the man is a Galilean.

7.w: And having learned that He is from the jurisdiction of Herod, he sent Him up to Herod, he himself being also in Jerusalem in those days.

8.w: And Herod, having seen Jesus, was exceedingly glad; for of a long time he is wanting to see Him, because of hearing concerning Him; and he was hoping to see some sign done by Him.

9.w: And he kept questioning Him in many words, but He answered him nothing.

10.w: And the chief priests and the scribes had been standing by, vehemently accusing Him.

11.w: And Herod, with his troops, having treated Him with contempt and also having mocked [Him], having put on [Him] splendid apparel, sent Him back to Pilate.

12.w: And both Herod and Pilate became friends with one another on that day; for previously they were at enmity between themselves.

13.w: And Pilate, having called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

14.w: said to them, “You⁺ brought to me this man as one misleading the people; and behold, having examined [Him] before you⁺, I found nothing in this man guilty of that accusation you⁺ are bringing against Him—

15.w: no, nor even Herod, for he sent Him back to us. And behold, nothing worthy of death is done by Him.

16.w: Therefore, having chastised Him, I will release [Him].”

18.w: But they cried out all together, saying, “Away with this [man], and release to us Barabbas,”

19.w: who was one having been cast into the prison on account of a certain insurrection having been made in the city, and murder.

20.w: Therefore Pilate, wanting to release Jesus, called to them again.

21.w: But they were crying out, saying, “Crucify! Crucify Him!”

22.w: And he said to them a third [time], “What evil indeed did this [man] commit? I found no cause of death in Him. Therefore having chastised Him, I will release [Him].”

23.w: But they were urgent, asking with loud voices for Him to be crucified. And their voices were prevailing.

24.w: And Pilate sentenced their demand to be done.

25.w: And he released the one having been cast into prison on account of insurrection and murder, whom they had asked for; and Jesus he delivered up to their will.

26.w: And as they led Him away, having laid hold on Simon, a certain [man] of Cyrene coming from the country, they put upon him the cross, to carry [it] behind Jesus.

27.w: And a great multitude of the people were following Him, and of women who were mourning and lamenting for Him.

28.w: But having turned to them, Jesus said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, do not weep for Me, but weep for yourselves and for your⁺ children.

29.w: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed [are] the barren, and the wombs that never did bear, and the breasts that never nursed!’

30.w: Then ‘they will begin to say to the mountains, “Fall upon us,” and to the hills, “Cover us.”’

31.w: For if they do these things in the green tree, what might happen in the dry?”

32.w: And two other criminals also were being led away to be put to death with Him.

33.w: And when they came to the place called The Skull, there they crucified Him, and the criminals, one on the right hand and one on the left hand.

34.w: And Jesus was saying, “Father, forgive them, for they do not know what they do.” And they cast lots, dividing His garments.

35.w: And the people stood, looking on. And the rulers also were deriding [Him], saying, “He saved others; let Him save Himself if this is the Christ of God, the Chosen One.”

36.w: And the soldiers also mocked Him, coming near, offering Him sour wine

37.w: and saying, “If You are the King of the Jews, save Yourself!”

38.w: And there was also an inscription over Him: THIS [IS] THE KING OF THE JEWS.

39.w: And one of the criminals having been hanged was railing at Him, saying, “Are You not the Christ? Save Yourself and us!”

40.w: But the other, answering, was rebuking him, saying, “Do you not even fear God, since you are under the same judgment,

41.w: and we indeed justly? For we are receiving back things worthy of what we did, but [this] man did nothing wrong.”

42.w: And he was saying, “Jesus, remember me when You come into Your kingdom!”

43.w: And He said to him, “Truly I say to you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”

44.w: And now it was about the sixth hour, and darkness came over all the land until the ninth hour,

45.w: the sun having darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in the middle.

46.w: And having called out in a loud voice, Jesus said, “Father, into Your hands I commit My Spirit.” And having said this, He breathed His last.

47.w: And having seen that having taken place, the centurion was glorifying God, saying, “Certainly this man was righteous.”

48.w: And all the crowds having come together to this spectacle, having seen the things having taken place, were turning back, beating [their] breasts.

49.w: But all from those who knew Him, and the women, those having followed Him from Galilee, stood afar off, beholding these things.

50.w: And behold, a man named Joseph, being also a Council member, a good and righteous man—

51.w: he was not having consented to their counsel and deed—from Arimathea, a city of the Jews, who was waiting for the kingdom of God,

52.w: he, having gone to Pilate, asked [for] the body of Jesus.

53.w: And having taken it down, he wrapped it in a linen cloth and placed it in a tomb cut in a rock, in which no one yet was laid.

54.w: And it was the Day of Preparation, and Sabbath was beginning.

55.w: And the women who had come with Him out of Galilee, having followed, saw the tomb and how His body was laid.

56.w: And having returned, they prepared spices and anointing oils. And they rested indeed on the Sabbath according to the commandment.
